verdict.rationale: Netlify ships an official CLI, installed via `npm i -g netlify-cli` and documented at docs.netlify.com/cli. It deploys sites, runs local dev servers and manages projects from the terminal. `netlify deploy --allow-anonymous` (no login needed to start) makes it easy to script from agent-driven workflows. A community report on Netlify Dev hit a public-folder error and found the netlify.toml docs unclear, which shows real use but also some friction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output or non-interactive modes beyond anonymous deploy), and independent corroboration that the CLI works smoothly in AI-agent workflows.
